subject: project:gdl
value: At 488c464166fc85d0e0cfa01e8c4aeb725feca069, --non-matching genuinely bypasses runtime/WebFrank/P6/retail rewrites but does NOT make configured NonMatching objects linker inputs. The actual default editable link has 341 inputs: 215 configured source/assembly and 126 extracted. ninja all_source compiles unfinished sources without linking them. A bounded scratch link that substitutes all 42 configured unfinished source objects, retaining 84 explicitly counted autogenerated data/BSS objects, fails before any boot test. Unchanged scratch control reproduces the production ELF byte-for-byte; the trial reports 65 multiply-defined plus 35 undefined diagnostics, 13 distinct undefined names, then too many link errors. These counts are LOWER BOUNDS, not exhaustive: a second actual link with documented -maxerrors 1000 still stops at 100 diagnostics. The failures include straightforward source-visibility mistakes and data ownership/name reconciliation; they are not evidence that unavailable compiler scheduling is the sole project blocker. No stubs, aliases, duplicate-tolerant flags, production source edits or default-mode changes were used to force the trial to link. Normal matching mode was restored and ninja prints main.dol: OK.
